Set up PSD lip sync and blinking

Animate a PSD avatar with your microphone in V Lens. Set up mouth and eye layers, try the built-in sample, and choose three-state or Japanese vowel lip sync.

The app interface is currently in Japanese. The instructions below include the Japanese menu and control labels.

Try lip sync with a built-in sample

  1. Open File (ファイル) → Built-in samples (内蔵サンプル) → Quick setup (three mouth shapes) (簡単セットアップ（3段階）). Closed, half-open and open mouth layers, plus automatic blinking, are already assigned.
  2. Under Audio / Lip sync (音声・リップシンク), select Microphone (マイク) and your usual input device.
  3. Click Start output (出力を開始) and speak. Watch the output monitor and adjust Mouth opening volume (口を開く音量) to set when the mouth opens.

Animate your own PSD avatar

Prepare an 8-bit RGB PSD with separate layers for mouth and eye variations. Load it with Open PSD… (PSDを開く…), select a mouth shape or eye state, then assign the matching layer.

Choose Three mouth states (3段階) for closed, half-open and open shapes, or Japanese vowels (vowel estimation) (あいうえお（母音推定）) for separate a, i, u, e and o shapes. Assign open and closed eye layers to enable automatic blinking. Expression presets let you switch to a smile or other expression with shortcuts during output.

If the mouth does not respond well

Check the audio meter to confirm that sound is reaching the app. For quiet speech or vocals over background music, try the Quiet voice / vocals with BGM (小声・BGMありボーカル) preset. If vowel detection has trouble with your voice, open Settings (設定) → Adjust vowel estimation… (母音推定を調整…) and record a, i, u, e and o in your normal voice.

To move the assignments to another PC, use File (ファイル) → Save PSD settings… (PSD設定を保存…) to save a JSON file. Copy the original PSD along with it.
